title: Readiness Review
description: CAT 531 textbook section on running a readiness review as a go/no-go launch gate: assigning traceable verdicts (go, no-go, conditional) to each prior toolkit artifact, holding a no-go on a safety, consent, or equity blocker, and recording rejected boundary-reversing shortcuts.
learning_objectives: Run a readiness review as a go/no-go gate: assign a traceable verdict to each prior artifact, let a single safety, consent, or equity blocker hold the launch, and record a rejected boundary-reversing shortcut.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to make a classroom technology decision more defensible.
